name: POST /api/leadflow/sequences/nurture/:ref/reactivate - return a record to an active owner, today
description:
Seven triggers return a nurtured record to its owner (0a3474c3-56f8-4af6-8931-eb27cfddc13c#AC3): a reply, a direct question, a booking, pricing or checkout activity, a referral, or a relevant product milestone.

THE TASK IS DUE TODAY, NOT QUEUED. A reactivation trigger is the prospect acting NOW; answering tomorrow wastes the signal that made them worth reactivating. The due date is set to end of the current day rather than to a fixed offset, so a trigger at 09:00 and one at 16:00 both produce a task due today.

A RESCORE IS REQUESTED because the record entered nurture under an old picture of them, and acting on a stale score is how a hot reactivation gets worked like a cold lead. The rescore degrades rather than blocking - the owner task is the part that matters and it lands either way. VERIFIED LIVE: reactivation created the same-day task; the rescore reported false because sdk-lead-scoring is unreachable here.

THE MEMBERSHIP IS EXITED WITH ITS REASON rather than deleted, so a record that has been reactivated three times is visible as such. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: Reactivating a record that is not in nurture is refused
NEGATIVE: an unknown trigger is refused
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: trigger must be one of reply, direct_question, booking, pricing_activity, checkout_activity, referral, product_milestone
No open nurture membership for that record
errorCases.when: the record is not currently in nurture.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
